biggest_catch: No single lump-sum bonus - the bonus is paid as six monthly credits, and every monthly analysis cycle requires eStatements + at least one direct deposit + 5 debit card purchases.
catches: Bonus paid as six monthly credits, not a lump sum: $25/month for Interest Plus (up to $150) or $50/month for Premier (up to $300).

During EACH monthly analysis cycle: enrolled in eStatements as of cycle end, at least one direct deposit transaction, and 5 or more debit card purchases debited from the account (excludes ATM transactions).
No explicit expiration date on official pages - offer may be withdrawn at any time.
Available in the Peoples Bank footprint: OH, WV, KY, VA, MD, Washington D.C.
Workplace Checking has a separate $100 x 3 = $300 variant; this route covers the consumer Interest Plus and Premier tiers.

payout_quote: Interest Plus Checking: Get Up to $150 When You Open a New Interest Plus Account. Open a new Interest Plus Checking account and receive a $25 credit monthly for the first 6 monthly analysis cycles following the account opening - up to $150 total. To be eligible for the bonus, during each monthly analysis cycle, you must: Be enrolled in eStatements as of the end of the monthly analysis cycle. Have at least one direct deposit transaction. Have 5 or more debit card purchases debited from your account (excludes ATM transactions). Premier Checking: To be eligible for the $50 monthly credit bonus, during each monthly analysis cycle, you must: Be enrolled in eStatements as of the end of the monthly analysis cycle. Have at least one direct deposit transaction. Have 5 or more debit card purchases debited from your account (excludes ATM transactions). Open with a $25 minimum deposit.

steps: Open a new Peoples Bank Interest Plus or Premier Checking account online or in-branch ($25 minimum deposit).
For each of the first 6 monthly analysis cycles: have at least one direct deposit transaction and 5 or more debit card purchases debited from the account.
Receive the monthly credit ($25 for Interest Plus, $50 for Premier) each cycle requirements are met - up to $150 or $300 total.
timing: $25 (Interest Plus) or $50 (Premier) credit paid monthly for the first 6 monthly analysis cycles following account opening when that cycle's requirements are met.
